Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve when I activate  on a digivolution card of a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and place a Tamer card?

Card Q&A.a: No, this card's inherited effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with the [SoC] trait in the trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect places a Tamer card in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [SoC] trait in your trash.
